verdict.rationale: Postman ships an official Postman CLI with detailed docs covering running collections, linting, security/governance checks, mock servers, and CI/CD integration, and explicitly documents giving coding agents CLI context for API discovery, code generation, and maintenance tasks, directly matching an AI-native CLI story. A probe confirms the CLI docs page is live and first-party. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community validation of AI-agent CLI usage beyond vendor docs.
